task_name: C4-H3: Employment intake in Washington with packet and note
intent: Open with exactly: "I was fired after I reported safety violations." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Harborline Industries." Washington. April fifth, twenty twenty six. Give a short account when asked. If they record intake, say exactly: "Please add an intake note that I still have the email I sent to HR about the safety violations." This is your mandatory reply the first time the agent says it has recorded your account or intake, or asks if there is anything else to add, even when that same turn also offers the packet by email or text. If the agent asks what the note should say, say exactly: "Just that I still have the email I sent to HR about the safety violations." If offered the packet, say exactly: "Email is fine." If offered a case evaluation or appointment, say exactly: "Not yet, let me read the paperwork first." Stay until they confirm the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file. A spoken promise that they will take care of it, without those writes, is not enough. Once they confirm the intake, the note, and the email packet are on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." Do not book an evaluation. End the call. The agent often says one moment or let me pull you up and then asks a question in the same turn. Always answer the question at the end of the agent's turn with the fact it asks for. Never reply with only "Sure", "Okay", "Yeah", or "Thank you" when the agent's turn ends in a question. Never say "Thank you, that's all I needed." while the agent is asking you a question, and never before the agent has said the note is added and the packet was sent by email.

parameters.note: Caller still has the HR email about the safety violations.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.

The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, whether any attorney represents you, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.

The agent asks who the claim or matter would be against, who the other side is, or for the name of the employer or company this would be against, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.

The agent asks when the incident happened, what date you were fired, let go, or terminated, or for the date including the year, even when the same turn starts with a filler such as one moment, let me pull you up, let me look you up, or I'll check that. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was April fifth, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether to send the packet by email or text, or which channel to use. NOT when asking for a company or employer name. NOT any other question.

The agent says it has recorded the intake or your account (for example 'I've recorded that'), or asks if there is anything else to add, including when the same turn also offers the packet by email or text. NOT before the agent has asked what happened. NOT during screening. NOT when asking whether anyone represents you, who this would be against, which state, or the date. NOT when you have already asked for the intake note.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please add an intake note that I still have the email I sent to HR about the safety violations. And email is fine for the packet.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent, including to send the packet or finish this. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want to book a case evaluation, a free evaluation, or an appointment, including right after saying the packet was sent. NOT when asking if there is anything else to add after intake, NOT when offering the packet by email or text, and NOT when you have already declined booking once and the agent is only saying take your time or call back when ready.
scripted_responses.response_value: Not yet, let me read the paperwork first.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent starts to wrap up, says goodbye, asks if that is all, or says to call back when ready, before those three writes (the intake, the note, and the email packet) are confirmed on the file. NOT after all three are confirmed. NOT during screening. NOT when the agent asks a question such as whether anyone represents you, who this would be against, the company name, which state, or the date.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need the intake, the HR-email note, and the email packet on the file.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent has said, in this turn or earlier, both that the intake note about the HR email was added and that the packet was sent by email, and this turn does not end in a question. NOT when the agent's turn ends in any question, such as email or text, your email or mailing address, what to put in the note, whether to book an evaluation, or whether anything else should be added. NOT when the agent has only said it recorded your account or intake. NOT when the note or the packet has not been confirmed. NOT during screening.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thank you, that's all I needed.

scripted_responses.response_value: I reported unsafe machine guards and blocked exits to HR, and they fired me the next day. I lost my wages.

The agent asks what the note should say, what to include in the note, or what to put in the note about the HR email. NOT any other question.
